{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "It shall be unlawful for any operator of a website or online service directed to children, or any operator that has actual knowledge that it is collecting or maintaining personal information from a child, to collect personal information from a child in a manner that violates the regulations prescribed under this part.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "any operator of a website or online service directed to children, or any operator that has actual knowledge that it is collecting or maintaining personal information from a child", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Generally, under this part, an operator must:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(a) Provide notice on the website or online service of what information it collects from children, how it uses such information, and its disclosure practices for such information (§ 312.4(b));", "force": "obligation", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "§ 312.4(b)"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(b) Obtain verifiable parental consent prior to any collection, use, and/or disclosure of personal information from children (§ 312.5);", "force": "obligation", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "§ 312.5"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(c) Provide a reasonable means for a parent to review the personal information collected from a child and to refuse to permit its further use or maintenance (§ 312.6);", "force": "obligation", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "§ 312.6"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(d) Not condition a child's participation in a game, the offering of a prize, or another activity on the child disclosing more personal information than is reasonably necessary to participate in such activity (§ 312.7); and", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "§ 312.7"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "(e) Establish and maintain reasonable procedures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of personal information collected from children (§ 312.8).", "force": "obligation", "binds": "an operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "§ 312.8"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "It shall be the obligation of the operator to provide notice and obtain verifiable parental consent prior to collecting, using, or disclosing personal information from children.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Such notice must be clearly and understandably written, complete, and must contain no unrelated, confusing, or contradictory materials.", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An operator must make reasonable efforts, taking into account available technology, to ensure that a parent of a child receives direct notice of the operator's practices with regard to the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information from children, including notice of any material change in the collection, use, or disclosure practices to which the parent has previously consented.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "An operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The direct notice to obtain the parent's affirmative consent to the collection, use, or disclosure of a child's personal information (including under § 312.5(c)(1)) shall set forth:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The direct notice to obtain the parent's affirmative consent", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "the voluntary direct notice to the parent of a child's online activities not involving the collection, use or disclosure of personal information (required under § 312.5(c)(2)) shall set forth:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the voluntary direct notice to the parent", "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.4(b)", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.4(b)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.5", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.5"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.6", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.6"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.7", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.7"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.8", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.8"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.5(c)(1)", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.5(c)(1)"},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.5(c)(2)", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR § 312.5(c)(2)"}
]}

{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Upon request of a parent whose child has provided personal information to a website or online service, the operator of that website or online service is required to provide to that parent the following:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator of that website or online service", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Upon request of a parent whose child has provided personal information to a website or online service"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The means employed by the operator to carry out this provision must:", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Ensure that the requestor is a parent of that child, taking into account available technology; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "taking into account available technology"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Not be unduly burdensome to the parent.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "prohibition_placeholder_removed", "text": "", "force": "", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "reference", "text": "§ 312.7", "cited_instrument": "16 CFR 312.7"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "An operator is prohibited from conditioning a child's participation in a game, the offering of a prize, or another activity on the child's disclosing more personal information than is reasonably necessary to participate in such activity.", "force": "prohibition", "binds": "An operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "The operator must establish and maintain reasonable procedures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of personal information collected from children.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "The operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "At a minimum, the operator must establish, implement, and maintain a written information security program that contains safeguards that are appropriate to the sensitivity of the personal information collected from children and the operator's size, complexity, and nature and scope of activities.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "written information security program"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Designate one or more employees to coordinate the operator's information security program;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Identify and, at least annually, perform additional assessments to identify internal and external risks to the confidentiality, security, and integrity of personal information collected from children and the sufficiency of any safeguards in place to control such risks;", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "at least annually"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Design, implement, and maintain safeguards to control risks identified through the risk assessments required under paragraph (b)(2) of this section.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "risk assessments required under paragraph (b)(2) of this section"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Each safeguard must be based on the volume and sensitivity of the children's personal information that is at risk, and the likelihood that the risk could result in the unauthorized disclosure, misuse, alteration, destruction or other compromise of such information;", "force": "obligation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Regularly test and monitor the effectiveness of the safeguards in place to control risks identified through the risk assessments required under paragraph (b)(2) of this section; and", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "Regularly"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "At least annually, evaluate and modify the information security program to address identified risks, results of required testing and monitoring, new or more efficient technological or operational methods to control for identified risks, or any other circumstances that an operator knows or has reason to know may have a material impact on its information security program or any safeguards in place to protect personal information collected from children.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "At least annually"},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Before allowing other operators, service providers, or third parties to collect or maintain personal information from children on the operator's behalf, or before releasing children's personal information to such entities, the operator must take reasonable steps to determine that such entities are capable of maintaining the confidentiality, security, and integrity of the information and must obtain written assurances that such entities will employ reasonable measures to maintain the confidentiality, security, and integrity of the information.", "force": "obligation", "binds": "the operator", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": "must obtain written assurances"}
]}
